verdict.rationale: Jeeves's own docs present it as one platform that combines spend (corporate cards and expense management), bill pay (invoice payments, approval flows and vendor management) and banking (multi-currency Jeeves Cash accounts with yield and FX). The docs state this can all be done 'from one digital account', which matches the consolidation story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that founders actually replace their separate tools with it, and fuller documentation of banking depth beyond multi-currency accounts in four currencies.

support.subject: As a founder, I can replace multiple point solutions for spend, bill pay, and banking with one consolidated platform

citations.quote: Manage cash in multiple currencies, issue cards, pay bills, and earn up to 5% annually\* all from one digital account.
Most companies bolt together five tools and call it a finance stack. Jeeves is one platform that happens to do four things.
Automate invoice payments and approval flows
Jeeves Cash: Multi-currency accounts with up to 5% yield, real-time FX conversion, and multi-currency balance storage.
Expense Management: Mobile receipt capture, real-time review, departmental budget controls, employee permissions, and global reporting.
